source_caption:
Certified Gangsta

Christopher Mintz-Plasse made his film debut as Fogell (McLovin) in the 2007 comedy Superbad at just 17 years old. Because he was only 17 during filming, his mother was legally required to be on set with him while shooting his intimate scene. He secured his breakout role by submitting an audition tape through Myspace after seeing a casting call. However, Jonah Hill initially did not want Mintz-Plasse cast in the role, feeling the young actor was too arrogant during their early interactions.

source_details.title: Superbad
source_details.synopsis: Superbad is a 2007 American coming-of-age teen buddy comedy film directed by Greg Mottola, written by Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg, and produced by Judd Apatow. It stars Jonah Hill and Michael Cera as Seth and Evan, two teenagers about to graduate from high school. Before graduating, the boys want to party and lose their virginity, but their plan proves harder than expected. Christopher Mintz-Plasse (in his film debut), Rogen, Bill Hader, Martha MacIsaac, and Emma Stone (in her film debut) provide supporting roles. Rogen and Goldberg wrote the script during their teenage years. It is loosely based on their experience in Grade 12 at Point Grey Secondary School in Vancouver during the 1990s. T
